title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: Liquid-phase operation can compromise the porous monolithic structure of some aerogel photocatalysts through capillary forces, whereas gas-phase operation introduces reactant-transport challenges.
explanation: The review contrasts structural damage on wetting with the ability of small gas molecules to enter pores, while noting limited gas delivery to active sites without liquid stirring.
scope: Aerogel photocatalysts in aqueous and gas-phase reactions.
conditions: Contact with liquid and low gas-phase reactant transport are the respective concerns.
caveats: These are design challenges, not evidence that all aerogels fail in liquid or gas operation.
